messages:
anita (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: hiring plan update and org tweaks. Net +28 roles across runtime, SRE, and Dedicated over Q2-Q3. Spreadsheet + slides: https://short.link/allhands/headcount :spiral_calendar:

sarah (CEO): Emphasis: reliability and enterprise readiness. Were allocating budget to runtime and Dedicated capacity first.

lee (Recruiter): Reqs go live this week. We'll tag priority roles in Greenhouse and share interview guides. Managers: add panel availability.

mike (VP Eng): Structurally, we'll spin up a Serving product area to centralize runtime PMs and priorities. Two PMs will move; two new PM hires planned.

jordan (Eng Manager): What about on-call and overflow while hiring? Teams are already at capacity.

mike (VP Eng): We'll adjust rotations and use a 90-day backfill policy for new hires to avoid overload. Eng-SRE hires specifically aim to drop alert volume per person.

recruit-bot: Job templates updated -> https://gh/jobs/templates. Use prefix 'Serving-' for runtime roles.

anita (People Ops): Will update org chart and hire sheet here once reqs are active. If you need a 1:1, book time with People Ops. :thumbsup:
